description: Labeled incidents for the deep-investigation (autonomous orchestrator) eval. Each label says what infrastructure type the service is, which cause keywords are CORRECT, and which patterns are a clearly-WRONG confirm (a cross-type category error or a fabrication). acceptableInconclusive lists the non-confirmed outcomes that are honest (not a failure) for that incident.

labels.summary: Bare-metal Consul-registered service (identity metric consul_health_service_status). When down, the correct cause is its Consul health check failing.
Bare-metal Consul-registered service. Correct cause is its Consul health check failing (or a shared dependency).

Kubernetes Deployment scaled to 0 replicas (kube_deployment identity metric). The correct cause is that it is scaled to zero / not running. Pod-level causes (GPU/readiness/OOM) are fabrications because no pods exist at 0 replicas.
